decisions.picked: Automation Cloud — standard, EU, modern folders; serverless API Workflow runtime unlimited; Integration Service fully available; IXP and Maestro BPMN blocked (not available); RPA available but limited (not needed here)
decisions.reason: Delivery model confirmed as Automation Cloud in org architectural considerations §1. Licensing table §2 applied: IXP not available, Maestro BPMN not available — neither is needed for this process. API Workflows fully available and serverless runtime has no limit (§5), making it unconstrained for this automation.

Pinned by the architecture job. Process is headless and system-to-system: Coupa REST query → in-memory filter loop → Slack REST send. Both systems have confirmed IS connections. No UI, no bot, no machine-local work. Org §3 preference: 'stable REST API exists for every system → API Workflow'. Serverless runtime available with no limit (§5).

PDD §14 explicitly states a simple in-memory loop is sufficient and no queue-based transactional pattern is indicated. Volume is up to 194 invoices per run — well below the ~200-item threshold for a Master Project per org §3. A single API Workflow project covers the full end-to-end sequence.

Both integrations (Coupa and Slack) use existing IS connections via the HTTP Request activity with authentication: connector, per org §4 approved pattern. No HITL (PDD explicitly excludes human approval, §4 scope out-of-scope). No custom connector needed (both connectors exist in catalog). No IXP (not available; not needed). No LLM activity (all filtering is deterministic rules). No Coded Function (string formatting is native in the workflow).

architect_review_items.question: When qualifying count = 0: BR-07 and section 4.3 say send nothing; section 7.1 says send a congratulations Slack message. Which behaviour is required?
architect_review_items.default_applied: No message sent on a clean day (BR-07 text is authoritative per PDD)

architect_review_items.question: BR-08/BR-09 text says no retry and no error notification; the future-state diagram shows retry up to 3 attempts and an error Slack message. Which is authoritative? If the diagram, what is the error message content?
architect_review_items.default_applied: No retry, no error notification; failed run reported in Orchestrator only (BR-08/BR-09 text is authoritative per PDD)

architect_review_items.question: The sample URL uses status_eq=draft only; BR-04 includes both draft and new. Should the Coupa link in the Slack message filter to draft+new, and does a combined parameter exist?
architect_review_items.default_applied: URL uses status_eq=draft only, verbatim from source section 4.3

architect_review_items.question: Does the Coupa invoice API paginate results? If page size is less than 194, the workflow must iterate pages to collect all records.
architect_review_items.default_applied: Single-page response assumed given observed sample volume of 194; developer must verify against Coupa API docs and implement pagination if needed

architect_review_items.item: Coupa PO-linkage field name on invoice lines
architect_review_items.question: What is the exact Coupa API field name on invoice lines that carries the proper PO linkage reference? The architectural considerations §4 live-run note mentions po-number and order-header-num on invoice-lines[] — developer must confirm which field satisfies BR-01/BR-02.
architect_review_items.default_applied: Use invoice-lines[].po-number / order-header-num per org considerations §4 live-run verification; confirm against Coupa API schema at build time
